title: Modern Treasury media slot
description: An empty media slot for product art, video or screenshots: a pale mint-to-paper wash at whatever size and ratio it is given, or the real media when passed in.
notes: size it with className (aspect-video, aspect-[2.76/1]…); children replace the wash
name: moderntreasury-media

props.name: children
props.description: the real image, video or art; the slot shows a soft wash while empty

props.name: label
props.description: what the media shows, for screen readers, while the slot is empty

props.name: className
props.description: size, ratio and radius of the slot
